design_rules: Net class MAINS (L, N, every relay COM/NO, valve and end-switch terminals, AC-input resistor chains, PSU input, fuse, MOV): minimum 6.4 mm clearance to every non-MAINS net including vias and copper pours; 8 mm where space allows. Reinforced insulation per IEC 62368-1 (3.0 mm / 5.0 mm) is the legal floor, 6.4 mm is the design floor.

No copper pour of any kind on the mains side of the board. Mains copper on the top layer only. Mains tracks for L-in and every relay COM/NO path at least 2.5 mm wide. No silkscreen, test points, fiducials or mounting holes inside the mains-to-SELV isolation gap; mounting holes at least 6.4 mm from mains copper.

Route a 1.0 mm wide slot in the board edge-cuts under every LTV-814S AC-input optocoupler and between the coil pins and contact pins of every HF32FA relay, extending at least 3 mm beyond the component body at each end.

Every relay MOSFET gate gets a 100 kOhm pull-down to GND and a 100 Ohm series resistor from the GPIO. Relay drives only on ESP32-C6 GPIO21, 22, 23 and 3; never on strapping pins GPIO8, GPIO9, GPIO15 or on U0TXD GPIO16. Relay status LEDs are wired from 5 V through 1 kOhm to the MOSFET drain, not to a GPIO. No MOV or snubber across relay contacts.

All mains terminals (WJ128V-5.0) on one board edge; USB-C, OpenTherm, 1-Wire, OLED, UART, Qwiic and buttons on the opposite edge. ESP32-C6-WROOM-1 on the SELV edge with its antenna overhanging the board edge and no copper or parts in the Espressif keep-out. Relays on the mains edge, away from the ESP module.

Each 230 V AC-input sense channel uses six 22 kOhm 1206 resistors in series laid out in a straight line on the mains side feeding an LTV-814S, with a 47 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V and 1 uF to GND on the output. Prefer JLCPCB Basic parts for all passives; use the LCSC numbers recorded in docs/design.md for everything else.

All mains and relay-side terminal blocks must be rising-cage clamp screw terminals that accept ferrule-terminated 1.0 to 1.5 mm2 wire (128-series type such as WJ128V-5.0, DG128, KF128-5.0). Never substitute a 301-series screw-on-wire terminal (KF301, DG301) on the mains side. Low-voltage terminals (OT, 1-Wire) may be 3.5 mm KF350 cage type.

Power and programming are USB-C only: VBUS feeds the 5 V rail directly (5.1 kOhm Rd on CC1 and CC2, SMF5.0A TVS on VBUS, USBLC6-2SC6 on D+/D-, GPIO12/13 to the receptacle). No on-board mains PSU, no UART-to-USB bridge, no UART header. The only mains on the board is the relay contact side and the AC sense inputs.
